Name: Ginger Island NPC Overhaul
Author: zoedoll
Description:
[size=5][b]Updated for 1.6 by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AirynS]Airyn[/url]!

Due to IRL stuff I am on a modding hiatus - I have enough time to answer comments and upload bugfixes or updates that other people give me, but not to update mods myself or add new features.[/b][/size][u][b]


1. Birdie[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Choose between Birdie's vanilla look (or any other portraits you may have for her) or a Pacific-Islander-inspired edit.
[*]Changes her backstory slightly (she is now also a former pirate) and she will now reference Leo and the pirates at the cove, along with some other small changes and additions to dialogue.
[*]Adds a new event if you visit her side of the island during the days when pirates visit the cove.
[/list]
[u][b]2. Professor Snail[/b][/u][list]
[*]When you complete his collection he is freed from his desk and will wander around the island as a real NPC
[*]Choose between Snail's vanilla look or a Pacific-Islander-inspired edit.
[*]Changes some of his dialogue to talk more about the island, the parrots, and theories about its history, as well as making him less of a Victorian bone-thief and more of a scientist and scholar. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] fans might recognise the name of the nearby university he works at!
[*]Choose between male Snail and female Snail (vanilla and Pacific Islander portraits/sprites available for both, choose "vanilla" or "modded" in portraits just as you would if Snail is set as male)
[/list]
Snail's gift tastes:
[list]
[*]Loves [spoiler]dinosaur eggs, plum pudding, tom kha soup, green tea, and crab cakes[/spoiler]
[*]Likes [spoiler]gems, minerals, and of course fossils![/spoiler]
[*]Hates [spoiler]mushrooms in any form[/spoiler]
[/list]
[u][b]3. The Gourmand Frog[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Makes his dialogue plainer/less Gungan
[/list]
[u][b]4. Leo[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Choose between Leo's vanilla look (or any other portraits you may have for him), Malaysian-inspired versions, Melanesian-inspired versions, or a new vanilla version in the same style.
[*]Changes Leo's storyline slightly so that he has been looked after by Birdie as well as the parrots during his time on the island.
[*]Adds some mentions of Birdie, Snail and the pirates to his dialogue along with other minor changes to his dialogue and events.
[*]The Airyn versions of his new portraits are compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11247]Seasonal Improved Leo[/url]﻿ and will wear his seasonal outfits if that is installed too!
[/list]
There are no edits made to the Ginger Island maps themselves so mods like which edit the Island farm, make tide pools walkable, etc, will still work!

[b][u]Configuration Options:
[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]Birdie Portraits [/b]- "vanilla" (either base game or any other portraits you have for her) or "modded" (Pacific Islander)
[*][b]Full NPC Snail [/b]- "on" (allows you to unlock Snail as an NPC once you've completed their collection), "off with portraits" (no NPC but allows you to change their portraits), or "off without portraits" (no NPC, leaves him default or with whatever other portrait you have for him)
[*][b]Snail Portraits[/b] - "vanilla" or "modded"
[*][b]Snail Gender[/b] - "male" or "female"
[*][b]Leo Portrait Style [/b]- "Zoedoll" or "Airyn"
[*][b]Leo Portraits - [/b]"off" (his base game portraits or any other portraits you may have for him), "ModdedVanilla", "Malaysian" or "Melanesian"
[*][b]The Gourmand[/b] - "vanilla" (his base game vanilla speech style), "modded" (a simple style that uses his original vague 1.5 dialogue edited to be less Jar Jar Binks) or "rhymes" (a fairytale style with rhyming couplets, thank you Airyn!), defaults to "rhymes".
[*][b]Leo Parrot Friend - [/b]enables [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11247]Seasonal Improved Leo[/url]'s parrot friend if it is installed! "Always", "Random" or "None", defaults to "Random"
[/list]
[u][b]Credits/Thanks:[/b]
[/u][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]Airyn[/url] for the new Leo portraits and sprites as well as a lot of code
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657] lemurkat[/url] for starting the work on NPC Snail
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/71424903]Asterisk[/url] for work on female Snail's sprites
[*][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Poltergeister]Poltergeister[/url] for male Snail's sprites
[/list]
[u][b]Known issues:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]The game sometimes needs to be reloaded for Professor Snail's behind-the-desk sprite to replaced when he becomes a proper NPC, so you may have two Snails for a little while if you don't!
[*]If this is installed [i]after[/i] you've seen Leo's events and he's moved to the Valley he may go back to his original schedule on the island.
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Built in compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11247]Seasonal Improved Leo[/url]﻿
[*]Should be compatible (in terms of code, lore is a whole other matter) with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url], SVE, etc. Mods that edit the same events and dialogue (e.g. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9708]Emyn's Diverse Ginger Island[/url] which provides a more thorough overhaul of Ginger Island's story content) will have issues, for now you'll need to pick one or the other.
[/list]
